# Day 11: Dynamic legend, image exporting, and animation across time

🔧 Technical Wins:
- Added a dynamic legend. Going forward, the dynamic aspect of the legend will be useful when I add parent and child lineages 
  in the fossil record, since depending on the time slice I am evaluating the model at, some fossils may or may not exist at 
  that time slice. I want the legend to reflect this automatically.
- Added an image-exporting function to ui.py. There is a toggle to turn this on or off. 
- Added animation.py as a module, which loops my code through time steps of 10 Ma, going from the present day to 250 Ma.
- All new features work!

🪛 Next:
- Each fossil should live on its own timeline, and this should be conceptually and operationally independent of the rewind time.
  The rewind time should act as a "slice" through all fossil "lifetimes" at the specified rewind time
- It looks like my "Present-day fossils" move, back in time. This is not what I would expect. To investigate.
- Onto Phase III!
